name: Animal welfare and trade: UK fish import tariffs, a precursor idea Ambitious Impact considered and did not recommend (2020); Animal Policy International was founded from its 2022 import-ban idea
summary: Animal welfare and trade: a precursor idea Ambitious Impact considered and did not recommend in 2020 (UK import tariffs on fish from countries with low welfare standards, so that fewer such fish are eaten). Animal Policy International was founded from AIM's 2022 import-ban idea; this is AIM's older model of the same kind of work and doesn't count in the ranking. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet. It comes out negative, −113 welfare points per dollar, because AIM subtracts what the co-founders and the funding would have achieved at other animal charities, and that loss outweighs the fish spared (+26 per dollar): AIM rejected the idea on this counterfactual. Our view keeps it, routing the fish gained and the other charities' welfare points lost (mainly chickens) through the species step separately; with credit by share of resources on, the counterfactual is replaced by shares of the cost and the result turns positive.

source.title: Animal Welfare and Trade (CE 2020 animal welfare report): CEA

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Ambitious Impact's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost.

sections.title: From welfare points to days of pain (ours)
sections.explainer: charityevals' bridge, not Ambitious Impact's. Ambitious Impact's welfare points (used until 2023) count one point of an animal's welfare score (−100 to +100) for one year, times its chance that the animal is sentient. We take the sentience discount out (Rethink Priorities' weights below already include it) and turn each welfare-point-year into days of disabling pain on the animal's own scale (shared figure, with a range).

sections.title: In chicken pain days
sections.explainer: charityevals' species step, the same for every animal model: days of pain for each species, weighed by how much it can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities).

rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact's counterfactual cost of the co-founders: the welfare points their time would have achieved elsewhere (valued at $25,000 a year each, at a high-impact charity's $0.0037 per welfare point). It outweighs the direct effect, which makes the result negative.

rows.label: Total WP loss
rows.explainer: AIM's counterfactual cost: the welfare points the co-founders' time and the funding would have achieved at other charities (valued at top animal charities' $0.0037 per welfare point). It outweighs the direct effect, which is why AIM rejected the idea. Our default view keeps it, as AIM published it; with credit by share of resources on, it is replaced by sharing the outcome among everyone who paid for it, so it counts 0.

rows.label: Discount on the costs (ours)
rows.formula: ((total_first_year_costs / (1 + max($discount_rate, 0.000001)) + charity_cost_per_year * ((1 - (1 + max($discount_rate, 0.000001)) ^ -total_years_operating_percentage_of_successes_attributable_t) / max($discount_rate, 0.000001) - 1 / (1 + max($discount_rate, 0.000001)))) * animal_welfare_and_trade_probability_of_success + total_first_year_costs / (1 + max($discount_rate, 0.000001)) * (1 - animal_welfare_and_trade_probability_of_success)) / animal_welfare_and_trade_total_expected_costs
rows.explainer: The same discounting for AIM's expected costs (the first year, then nine more years if the campaign succeeds), so benefits and costs are discounted alike; welfare points per dollar are divided by this.

rows.label: Welfare points per dollar you give, before the sentience discount: farmed fish
rows.explainer: Unlike Ambitious Impact's later sheets, this one doesn't multiply by a probability of sentience: it counts fish spared times the welfare score of their country of origin (one year each), so there is nothing to divide out.

rows.label: Days of disabling pain spared per dollar you give: farmed fish
rows.explainer: Welfare-point-years for farmed fish times the days of disabling pain one welfare-point-year stands for (shared figure: 2.1, range 1.09 to 9.09, calibrated on Ambitious Impact's own welfare points and suffering-adjusted days for hens moved out of battery cages). These are the animals' own days, before weighing by species.

rows.label: Probability that the animals of the forgone work are sentient (chickens)

source.title: Charity Entrepreneurship, welfare points by animal (2018), 'Aggregate different animals' tab

rows.explainer: AIM values the counterfactual loss in other charities' welfare points at a benchmark of $0.0037 per welfare point for high-impact charities ('Animal welfare and trade'!D41), top animal charities whose work is mainly chicken campaigns. Our judgment: count the loss as chickens' welfare points. This sheet's points aren't sentience-adjusted, so to set them beside the fish (whose points are divided by nothing here) we divide by AIM's 70% for hens (CE 2018 sheet, caged and enriched-cage hens), whose points elsewhere are sentience-adjusted. This turns the loss into chicken welfare points given sentience before Rethink Priorities' weights. High end 1 (range is ours): if the welfare points behind Ambitious Impact's $0.0037 benchmark were not sentience-adjusted, nothing is divided out; this input decides the sign.

rows.label: Welfare points per dollar you give, before the sentience discount: chickens (lost)
rows.explainer: AIM's counterfactual loss per dollar you give, counted as chickens' welfare points and negative.

rows.label: Days of disabling pain spared per dollar you give: chickens (negative: lost elsewhere)
rows.explainer: The lost welfare-point-years times the days of disabling pain one welfare-point-year stands for (shared figure: 2.1, range 1.09 to 9.09), discounted like the fish's gain because the forgone work spans the same years.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: farmed fish
rows.explainer: The days of pain for farmed fish, weighed by how much fish can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities; mean of carp and salmon).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: chickens (negative)
rows.explainer: The days of pain for chickens, weighed by a chicken's capacity to suffer, 1 by definition.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Days of disabling pain spared for the fish minus those lost at other charities (counted as chickens'), all counted as a chicken's. The headline converts this into years of healthy life with the chicken slider and the healthy hours lost per day of disabling pain.
